calibrate() does not bucket wards into central/inner/outer/peripheral tiers. Every ward in a city shares the same per-category scale factor derived at runtime from monthly_stats.json totals vs. seeded breakdowns. Effective weights therefore vary by city and refresh cycle, not by ward tier. To audit live values for a city, divide that city's YTD total for a category by the sum of seed breakdown counts for that category across its wards.
